requested_authorization.scope_received: one-shot frozen locked-test inference, raw prediction persistence, comparator lookups, and final statistical evaluation

blocking_findings: The frozen configuration does not bind the ML-extension protocol hash.
The frozen configuration records only the combined development manifest and record-set hashes; separate TRAIN and VALIDATION manifest bindings are absent.
The frozen configuration does not bind the exact preprocessing, model revision, raw feature artifact hash, or comparator provenance required for locked execution.
No serialized fitted classifier coefficients/intercept or immutable fitted-model artifact for evo2__logistic_regression_hpo exists in the Phase 8-13 output tree.
The Phase 8 summary registers evo2__logistic_regression, evo2__mlp, and evo2__decision_stump, but does not register evo2__logistic_regression_hpo.
The frozen configuration names isotonic calibration but does not bind the fitted isotonic mapping artifact or its hash.
No frozen abstention rule, abstention threshold, or abstention artifact is recorded in the configuration.
No random-seed binding for refit, calibration application, bootstrap, or paired comparisons is recorded in the configuration.
The requested locked NT/Caduceus tracks are not required by the frozen feature_set=evo2 configuration; running them would widen the actual frozen workload.
decision: STOP before locked-test inference and do not create or consume a paid Phase 14 approval until the selected development configuration is made complete and content-bound using development evidence only.
